what: Levantine (Shami) voice catalogue for the StudyAI film: the four auditions the user called excellent, cloned so they can be reused on new copy, plus verified Fish stock voices for the other Arabic accents and for English narration.
how: A voice is only listed with an id that was resolved through the Fish API in this session: clones from POST https://api.fish.audio/model (state=trained, instantly usable as reference_id), stock ids from GET https://api.fish.audio/model/{id} followed by a real TTS + ASR round-trip. Nothing here is a guess.

film.note: Per line: b01 4.117 s, b02 6.562 s, b03 5.193 s, b04 4.997 s, b05 4.900 s. Every line fits its beat with the 0.35 s air the timeline requires.

not_verified: Shadda audibility: the ASR gate strips harakat, so a shadda cannot be verified by the gate. The delivered fixes are (a) explicit shadda + vowel, (b) a slower speed, (c) measured silence and no clipped onset; the last judgement is by ear on the files in out/auditions.
Accent and gender of stock voices are read off their public titles; nobody has listened to them for this film.
Licence/terms of the public Fish models: the ids work, but using someone else's published voice model in a client film is a licensing decision, not a technical one.
Register per voice is a median-F0 estimate from contiguous speech frames (60-400 Hz band), accurate to about an octave; pace is the probe's words per second.
